_comment: Manual citation metrics fallback. Keys = normKey(title, year, lastName). Run normKey() in browser console to generate keys. All fields optional. Updated entries override Dimensions API data for that key.

_schema.googleScholar: integer — cited-by count from Google Scholar
_schema.googleScholarUrl: string  — direct link to GS record (Scholar search or profile)
_schema.dimensionsUrl: string  — direct link to Dimensions record
_schema.updatedAt: string  — ISO date this entry was last manually updated
